domains.gap: CLI discovery, ACP startup, a read-only four-check Doctor, and signed-out remediation UI are covered; cached credential presence is not server-validated, and packaged auth transitions plus timeout-specific remediation remain.

Project lifecycle, health recovery, pin-group ordering, restart persistence, and fixed-target Open in are covered through strict IPC and Electron E2E. Unlike Swift LaunchServices lookup, nonstandard app install locations may be hidden; an app disappearing after discovery returns a fixed error instead of falling back to Finder.

Session create/duplicate/select/close, durable project selection, lazy load, stale fallback, pins, bounded LRU, and canonical fork->child load have v5/UI/E2E coverage. Gaps: the full five-session mixed-state matrix, and remote-child orphan risk if the app crashes after fork acceptance or the workspace is adversarially replaced during the RPC.

No known gap in plan/question interaction handling or authoritative current-mode synchronization.

Model, mode, per-session effort, rollback, and capability parsing work. A local Saved Agent can now bind to one chat, supply a strict inline profile to session/new and session/load, survive restart/resume, and recycle only affected idle workers after profile changes. Still partial: reasoning effort is not project-scoped, linked TOML roles have no atomic transaction/rollback, broader pre-handshake capability truth remains, and no signed-in real-CLI Saved Agent profile smoke is committed.

Secure file/image selection, opaque leases, renderer chips, Swift-order ACP content blocks, and no-byte/no-path persistence canaries are covered end to end; mentions, slash commands, goal creation/control, per-session queue, and steer remain. Swift-priority status/unread, local project/title plus bound Saved Agent name/mission search, Agent badges, schema-v5 settled/pinned shelves, six-group current-project Dashboard with bounded Git projection and a live PAR-014 Scheduled source, distinct opaque-token CLI History list/search/ACP-open/native-delete, native modal focus, and four PAR-011 visual baselines are covered. Memory has a staged durable policy, bounded browser/preview, global remember, native-confirmed session deletion, and private state. Remaining: targeted TOML, secret storage, providers/models, linked role CRUD/rollback, compatibility, hooks, skills, and plugins.

Read-only CLI-owned activity is wired end to end: typed scheduler/background/workflow/goal updates are primary, the pinned scheduler fallback is bounded, replay/live/offline state is explicit, public/persisted state excludes raw IDs, live work owns LRU protection, and E2E/visual evidence covers the UI. Still partial: no controls or short-lived action tokens, no per-activity Saved Agent assignment, no real signed-in CLI scheduler/workflow/goal smoke, and no Quit continuation guarantee.
Sanitized GFM and basic code/table rendering exist; smashed tables, Mermaid, LaTeX discrimination, comprehensive protocol sanitation, and scoped local image/video delivery remain.

The selected-project branch/worktree/dirty projection reaches Dashboard through zero-argument strict IPC, stability checks, unit tests, and a temporary-repository isolation E2E. Read-only diff summary/fixed-scope patch APIs remain main-only; checkout, worktree creation, full diff review, commit, and PR actions remain.

App/CLI zero-argument native-confirmed installs work. App: one-shot authority, trust checks, quiescence, Squirrel replacement. CLI: strict semver/prerelease, target-pinned command, exact local version authority, best-effort feed display, ambiguous-result retained gates/guarded quit, startup/quit barriers. Missing: signed App old-to-new/recovery evidence for a real release, real managed-CLI capture/rollback, skip/dismiss parity, copied-archive digest proof, and post-launch crash rollback.

Content-free lifecycle notifications, deduplication, foreground suppression, cancel guard, and click routing are covered; permission-denied state and packaged dedicated-user TCC smoke remain.

Public error taxonomy, corrupt-state quarantine, stale-load fallback, Doctor remediation, and deduplicated explicit retry without prompt replay are covered; queued-delivery recovery and complete packaged crash/fault scenarios remain.

Renderer sandboxing, narrow bridge validation, URL policy, MCP canary redaction, and display sanitizers exist; a comprehensive runtime canary through stderr, malformed stdout, RPC data, transcript, state, notifications, and logs remains.

Package hardening, sealed feed, secret-free unsigned smoke, credential cleanup, exact ZIP final trust verification, archive trust, state import, and Squirrel handoff work; CLI install does not supply App release proof. No signed positive artifacts exist.
